01 About

The bridge between finance, HR, and payroll brought me to my current role.

I currently support the implementation of HR and payroll functions for Los Angeles County school districts. My work sits between functional needs and system configuration—from pay policies and work calendars to benefits, retirement, positions, and employee data.

Through this work, I realized I have a strong interest in learning the intricacies of Human Resources—how policy, employment laws, and organizational objectives shape the employee experience and affect the public we serve.

What I enjoy most is the human side: training users, asking questions, communicating through change, and building trusted relationships with the people I support. Those experiences have made me want to grow a long-term career in Human Resources.
